notes.title: Two new game modes, more bad ass baddy deaths, and weapon buffs are waiting...
notes.content:
[h1]Version 3.2.0 Build Notes[/h1]

[previewyoutube=73vu7YFoyhI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Big Highlights:[/h1]
[h3]🚀 New Game Mode: Caravan 1 — Blast your way to glory in this action-packed, 5-minute high-score chase![/h3]

[h3]🏁 New Game Mode: Race 1 — Speed thrills and thumb skills: rubbing is racing in this lightning-fast thumb-warmer-upper![/h3]

[h3]💥 Enemy Death FX Upgrade — Dramatically improved enemy death sounds and visual effects. Blowing demonic beasties away has never felt so satisfying![/h3]

[h3]🌟 Scoring Boost — Tweaked scoring system to reward your skillful gameplay even more generously.[/h3]

[h3]🔫 Player Weapons Revamp — Weapon sets have been finely tuned with buffs and improvements to underperforming sets. Time to discover your new favorite weapon![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44131144/62d5fbd5aac154bfb1135b4b8a08929457b5fbdd.png[/img]

[h2]Caravan Mode Explained:[/h2]

Dive into an intense 5-minute high-score battle, perfect when you're short on time but high on adrenaline. Share your best runs on Discord to compete on our community leaderboard!

What exactly is Caravan Mode? Caravan Mode is an iconic gameplay format popularized by Hudson Soft’s classic shmups like Star Soldier. Famous for their roadshow competitions, kids would challenge their parents head-to-head, competing for glory and prizes. We’re honored to bring this thrilling experience into Interstellar Sentinel.

Caravan Improvements Change List:
[list]
[*]Added a complete end-level ranking system—perfect for bragging rights.
[*]Introduced a no-death bonus replacing pacifist mode—can you master the art of staying alive?
[*]Visual effects got a serious glow-up—projectile impacts and explosions have never looked this spectacular!
[*]Enemy AI refined—every fight stays fresh, fierce, and engaging.
[*]Sneaky secrets added—rumors hint something intriguing might be hiding in suspicious flesh walls. Happy hunting!
[*]Hidden goodies now cleverly concealed in flesh walls later in the level.
[*]Monster Trophies introduced—showcase your mastery of combat by collecting them all!
[*]Advanced Head Toss mechanic (MT Advanced Head Toss)—perfect your tossing technique!
[*]Skele Schoochers now join the action earlier to ramp up the excitement.
[*]Popcorn enemies now appear after dragons, warming you up for the Soul Blight Reapers.
[*]Brood Mother received a fresh Caravan makeover—now featuring a face only a mother could love. Ready for the challenge?
[*]Sea Satans elevated for clearer visibility.
[*]Head Flayer animations improved.
[*]Shadestress timing optimized.
[*]Reduced mini Skullzoar spawn rate.
[*]Brood Mother escapes sooner—catch her quickly!
[*]Exit portal glow effect enhanced.
[*]"Exit Portal" message clarity improved.
[*]Second Mecha Demon Chopper’s timing adjusted.
[*]Mini combo maintainers added to second Brood Mother.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44131144/3aed1afbdf1760921f17023d8b9f532eb8822383.png[/img]

[h2]Race Mode Explained:[/h2]
Follow the green glowing race lines and speed powerups to go fast. Don't plow into the environment and mix in micro and macro dodging. Collect the Lokis, and monster trophy medals to rack up that high score and chain combo meter. Don't forget to shoot to keep your chain combo meter going and use your super to make your own shortcuts through the environment! 

[list]
[*]We've implemented and tweaked the end level rank system to support the new mode. The mode is being iterated on based on community playtest feedback. 
[*] Added in Lokis for life and super power up pickups
[*] Added race go fast vroom mechanic powerups
[*] Extended level design routes
[*] Monster trophy medal added
[*] Music randomizer added
[*] No miss death bonus added
[*] Time score bonuses added
[/list]
Share your thoughts and gameplay feedback with us!

[h2]General Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed crashes during boss encounters.
[*]Resolved graphical glitches with enemy animations.
[*]Corrected audio synchronization issues.
[*]Fixed Shadestress Monster Trophy issue.
[*]Fixed player death registration.
[*]Corrected C & D rank issue.
[*]Fixed naming inconsistencies.
[*]Fixed initial power-down issue.
[*]Fixed music volume and tagging issues.
[*]Corrected Monster Trophy bullet cancellation issue (Fortress of Flesh).
[*]Adjusted Loki strings between bosses to maintain combo chains.
[*]Improved Shadestress encounter timing.
[*]Fixed music track selection logic.
[*]Increased overall music volume.
[*]Added Beta tag to 9HBR.
[*]Fixed issue with Loki strings after Scarzen boss.
[*]Adjusted swirl bullet patterns on Bronchress.
[*]Added warning indicators for Scarzen boss approach.
[*]Enhanced Heaven Scatter Shot weapon.
[*]Added giant laser on Brood Mother's backside at laser gate start.
[*]Adjusted bullet patterns for Final Astral Ripper.
[*]Corrected collision damage for Sea Satan.
[*]Added particle system to Sreevanix plasma laser.
[*]Fixed issue where Monster Trophy kills didn't cancel bullets (Fortress of Flesh).
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

The Interstellar Sentinel Team

Also here is my playthrough of the 3.2.0 build:
[previewyoutube=JNYHcRc8KOo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Game Mode: 9 Hells Boss Rush
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P-FYOFpUygo

[h1]Big new mode! 9 Hells Boss Rush![/h1]
[list]
[*] Recommended for players familiar with the existing game features. This mode was built to leverage all your acquired skills and then turn up the heat for some sweet boss rushing in a 15-minutes or less experience. 
[*] Reimagined bosses and attack patterns in a time.
[*] We hear you like bosses for your boss rush mode, so how about finding all the mini bosses between the bosses?
[*] We brought in a music randomizer to keep the experience fresh for your ears.
[*] Hop on over to our Discord and post your high scores!
[/list]

[h2]General:[/h2]
Performance and optimization improvements

[h2]Audio Mix:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted audio levels across the game
[*] Minor audio adjustments to some enemy weapons
[*] Voice volume: Super weapon online, increased volume slightly
[*] Voice volume: Extra Ship volume, decreased volume
[*] Adjusted title screen track to be more epic when it comes in
[*] Various minor tweaks to some player and enemy weapons
[/list]

[h2]Player Weapons:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Quad laser is now a homing shot
[*] Infini laser weapon set got a slight buff to the laser. The auto shot is now homing too
[/list]

[h2]Levels:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Weapon Room: - Fly Here, blink text
[*] Minor bug fixes to flow surrounding monster trophies
[/list]

[h2]Enemies:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the Decarabia Haunted Wheels doing too much damage on collision
[/list]

[h2]Steam Deck:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Test with the latest Steam Deck updates
[*] Note: You still need to enable proton experimental compatibility mode
[/list]

[h2]Special Thanks[/h2]
A very special thank you to all our community members for all the playtesting and feedback!

notes.title: Build 2.2.0 is now live with a brand new feature Weapon Dumper!
notes.content:
[h1]Build 2.2.0 is now live with a brand new feature Weapon Dumper![/h1]


[h2]New Feature: Power Downer![/h2]
You're in for a treat! Now, just hit that triangle or Y button to unleash the Power Downer – a nifty power-up right in the middle of the screen! These little boosts are limited but fear not, they refresh every level. Perfect for those who fancy their weapon sets but still want to snag power-ups for a high score or to tweak their strategy. Happy Shmupping!

[h2]General:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've slimmed down the game download size by optimizing assets on disc.
[*] Shield design got a makeover! Now, your pacifist mode force field lets you keep an eye on your weak spot.
[*] Score & Bonus multiplier points text is now a tad larger for your reading pleasure.
[*] Brace yourselves for Challenge level 4 with a spanking new track.
[/list]

[h2]Pacifist Mode:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pacifist Mode just got an upgrade! It not only cancels enemy bullets but also spawns soul bits on pickup. How cool is that?
[/list]

[h2]Multiple Endings:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Every ending now comes with a unique number and a dash of silly messages. Explore them all!
[/list]

[h2]Secret Fails:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Secret hunting! Now, there's a negative sound effect when the secret slips through your fingers.
[/list]

[h2]Monster Trophies:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Monster Trophy hints are clearer with high score text added to make your hunting even sweeter.
[/list]

[h2]Weapons:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Electro orb is now easier on the eyes with improved visibility and smoother animation.
[*] Singularity burst weapon's missing charge up SFX has been fixed.
[*] Portal guns got a makeover – now more transparent to reduce visual distraction.
[/list]

[h2]Penta Shot & Tri Scythe Laser Set:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Main forward projectile now has a ring weapon type spread.
[*] Penta Energy Lance Shot got a damage boost and spiffier visuals.
[/list]

[h2]Singularity Boom Shot Set:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolution of the bottom singularity orb has been cranked up for your viewing pleasure.
[/list]

[h2]Flazer Set:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Flazer got a trim – slightly shorter for a balanced performance.
[/list]

[h2]Intro Cutscene:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We gave the intro cutscene a little polish, sprucing up the visuals and sound effects.
[/list]

[h2]Audio:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Music and sound effects are rebalanced across all levels. Feel free to reset to defaults for the latest tunes.
[*] Boss battle music volumes are fine-tuned for an epic showdown.
[/list]

[h2]Advanced Head Toss:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Small head toss explosions won't deafen you – we dialed down the volume.
[/list]

[h2]Extra Ship VO:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced volume on extra ship voiceovers for a smoother auditory experience.
[/list]

[h2]Level 02:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Loki strings now stay on screen during pacifist mode, avoiding a wild escape to the bottom.
[/list]

[h2]Level 03:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Watch out! Danger warning indicators are now in place for columns and big rocks at the start.
[/list]

[h2]Final Boss:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We tightened up the time bonus award for a more thrilling finish. Enjoy!
[/list]

**Bigger Notable Changes:**
- DrBossKey now has flapping wings just like the heavens of supernatural mischief intended!
- Player bullets now draw behind the player so you no longer need to panic when not being able to see your weak spot
- Reorganized HUD for improved readability of super meter, health, monster trophy medals, and lives.
- Balancing and tuning passes across the weapon sets
- Various gameplay tweaking and tuning across the levels to improved difficulty for newcomers and shmup veterans 
- Two new music pieces have been added!
- Fixed spawn portals not appearing when enemies were teleporting in 
- Updated the visual indicator for the super weapon ready VFX surrounding the player weak spot.
- Updated gun portal animation and added second gun type for missiles
- Performance and optimization passes across the game. We’re running at a stable 60fps on a Steam Deck!
- Changed extends to not grant extra lives every 5M points, but instead are now tied to difficulty select and activating pacifist mode


**Music and Sound:**
- Added music fade-down before boss battles.
- Added warning sound effects for boss warnings.
- Adjusted boss battle music to sync with track text appearance.

**UI and Visual Improvements:**
- Moved the help image in difficulty selection to align with the left screen UI border.
- Reduced boss name display time by a second or two.
- Updated the weak spot graphic color to purple in the tutorial.
- Centered the SC logo on the logo screen.
- Improved weapon room functionality and second section for better weapon testing.
- Removed the score from the level select secret.
- Added an airlock sound effect for the ship entrance.
- Improved weapon spread for top weapons at the origin spot to enhance point-blanking with spread shot weapons.
- Tutorial and level select environments have been updated to reflect cosmic soup.

**Level-Specific Changes:**
[b]Tutorial:[/b]  
- Slowed down the parallax of the grid by half.
- Updated HP help arrow in the tutorial to point to the new location.
- Moved monster hint and spawn to the left in the tutorial.
- Adjusted monster trophy hint text in the tutorial.

[b]Level 01:[/b]  
- Level 01: Located the extra ship at the end of the level near the boss.
- Investigated an issue where collected secrets didn't count on the rank screen.
[b]Level 03:[/b]  
- Fixed secret found logic and rank collection.
- Fixed advanced monster trophy hint to ensure it's attached to the actual monster trophy.

[b]Level 04:[/b]  
- Fixed drawing order for secret guide circle.
- Investigated dark wellspring flames not appearing for dark avian mage spawns in Level 4.
- Adjusted pacifist mode in Level 4 to leave the initial spawned state for 1.5 seconds more before moving down into the dark wellspring. I also added a big teleportation indicator to keep from accidentally collecting pacifist powerup too soon.

[b]Level 06:[/b]  
- Ensured that the monster trophy spawns after pacifist mode and hid the player until the boss defeat sequence is complete.
- Fixed the monster trophy in challenge level 6 after the last long undead dragons appeared if the previous enemy criteria were not complete.

[b]Level 08:[/b]  
- Hid the helper circle VFX for tentacle spinner flesh tendrils.
- Weapon plate before long flesh wall spawners adjusted.
- Tuned miniboss encounter and monster trophy spawn requirements
- Adjust some power up flows

**Rank System Updates:**
- Improved conveyance by swapping the negative mark with an X.
- Added Monster Trophy counts for each level to indicate how many can be collected.

**Visual and Audio Adjustments:**
- Updated the miniboss visuals for Frozen Shadestress, Spider Demon tank, and Robonoid.
- Audio balancing for music and sfx.

**Other Changes:**
- Added a Discord QR code to the title screen.
- Changed the back key message on the Title Screen to "Escape."
- Restarted ranked music in the credits.

Thanks, everyone, for playing and for all the incredibly positive feedback! This version of the game feels much better to me, and I am looking forward to seeing how it feels to you!

[h1][center]Big news! We're included in the Steam Shmup Fest sale![/center][/h1]


[h1][center]Interstellar Sentinel 2.0.1 Build Notes[/center][/h1]

[b]Level & Gameplay Tweaks:[/b]

- New ship intro for all levels, it's DELICIOUS!

• Level 03:
  - Checking Monster Trophy timing in pacifist mode for a late grab.

• Level 04:
  The camera now stops once the boss is defeated.
  - Adjusted Lesser demon bonus spawn in Gondus fight to be higher and pushed back a little more to the right side of the screen. They were a little too devilish to deal with...
  - Fixed weak spot layering against player weapon layering order.

• Level 08:
  - Watch out for duplicate flesh walls near the end of this level.

• Super Weapon Shenanigans:
  - Fixed score going wild with the super weapon bullet cancel.

• General:
  - Moved DBK spawn to center stage left.
  - Item scoring and extra lives score fixes (it was possible with insane monster trophies to gain over 80K lives...)

[b]Weapon and Ability Adjustments:[/b]
  - Gun portals are now adjusted!
-- Top gun portal is aligned with your weak spot to give guidance without having to look at your weak pot
-- Bottom gun portal is brought forward to not catch the eye as much and to bring all visual information together. This also tightens up the weapon-switching efficiency by not creating as far of a sightline leading for the bullets
-- Auto gun portal is now higher and further back to provide more combat utility. Let us know what you think!

• Triple Scythe Laser:
  - Adjusted this back to the gun portal version without the summoned gun.
  - Front scythe beam extends out a further
  - Nerfed damage. This thing was ripping bosses into new dimensions...

• Infini Laser:
  - Damage buffed.

• Top & Bottom Spinning Cannon Vertical Spread Shot:
  - Tuned down vertical spread weapon damage.
  - Tuned up damage on the quad plasma laser.
  - Buffed the cross quad plasma laser weapon set.

• Weapon Set 11 (Octo Plasma Laser + Missile Fan):
  - Missile fan has a shorter loop between missile salvos after the initial charge rate.
  - Fixed top weapon alignment on weapon set 09 (Penta Spread Shot with reverse ripple shot).
  - Adjusted fire rate on the bottom missile fan to be stronger, faster, and beefier in the nacho department


[b]Visual and Audio Enhancements:[/b]

• Player Weak Spot and Visuals:
  - Updated player weak spot visuals and tweaked layering order with player bullets.
  - Adjusted weapon positions to give more guidance and visibility for the player's weak spot.
  - Adjusted health up sound effects.
  - Forced DBK into better acting classes for weapon up and weapon down voice lines.

[b]User Interface and Progression:[/b]
- You can now view your highscores from the main menu
- Update the super weapon visual effect position to be centered around the DrBossKeys weak spot
- Updated title screen with cooler art and a chill scroll.
• Level ending postcards - Changed to a button hold and press backup for dismissing the ending image. 
 

So there you have it, Sentinels! Our [b]Interstellar Sentinel 2.0.1[/b] has seen polish and tuning across lots of places!. Get out there and restore balance to Sreevus's twisted universe!

Hello Sentinels! 

[h1]Major Update:[/h1]
[h2]The player character starship has been replaced with DrBossKey[/h2]
We've received a ton of positive feedback to pursue this direction and hope you enjoy it as much as we do! For people who have previously purchased the game and would like to remain on the previous version of the game with the starship, please email us upliftinggoat(at)gmail.com with your Steam receipt, and we'll send you a link to that stand-alone version (DRM free). Thank you very much for all the support.

[previewyoutube=wORII75qA9M;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Updates[/h2]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
- New boss battle music has been added, Vampirial Remnants
- Audio mix improvements
- SFX updates for many enemies, and weapons
- Player damage, upgrades, downgrades sound updates

[previewyoutube=TNn4xZ-axRE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Weapons[/h3]
- Updates to underperforming weapon sets with new functionality and damage tuning across all the weapon sets
- Weapon system adjustments to top, mid, and bottom weapon positions to improve utility of the weapon systems
- Fixed a bunch of bugs (audio, visual effects, and more)

[h3]Other[/h3]
- Performance optimizations across the game 
- Improved Monster Trophy and enemy spawns to smooth out the difficulty curve between new and experienced players
- Player screen border collision is now adjusted to improve power up collecting


[h3]Levels[/h3]
- Level 03 fixed monster trophy criteria for early monster trophies making the level more challenging than it should have been
- Level 03 third monster trophy criteria fixed and additional demon turret spawns fixed
- Level 03: boss, switched out one weapon upgrade with a health powerup in the Scarrzan sequence to help players' survivability
- Level 04: First monster trophy tuned a little tighter to not be achieved as easily
- Level 04 Added a summoning portal in front of pacifist mode
Level 04: If all monster trophies at the start are collected Gonuds adds his bullet homing attack to the bullet hell sconce sequence
- Level 05: Miniboss was appearing when it shouldn't have. He was too excited to greet players so we put him back in the box for more experience Sentinels
- Level 07, adjusted weapon power up spawn slightly to not stack on top of each other
- Level 08 Tune down bullet speed for first barrage slightly
- Level 08 smashers, final smasher waterfall, the waterfall is now in the background 
- Level 08: Add warning to flesh-tendril walls appearing and thin them out from the geometry. Adjusted spawning in general 
- Credits: Removed shoot to continue text once the ending screen is seen
Credits: No longer triggering final dialogue if Astral Ripper is alive


[h3]Enemies[/h3]
- Fixed Treant arms are doing more damage than they should have and causing one hit deaths
- Lost soul lanterns, increased projectile size since they're slow butt pokers
- Mecha demon chopper fixed sound overruns causing a ruckus 
- Gondus fight, First naeda and hammer, naeda was left alive when gondus died causing issues during the rank screen

notes.title: Build 1.0.3 is Live!
notes.content:
Thank you, everyone, for all the feedback and playtesting!

[list]
[*] Level 4: Fixed Post boss death enemy Naeda was still spawning after Gondus death 
[*] Level 4: fixed Nada appearing during rank screen.
[*] Level 03: Miniboss cancels its bullets on death now
[*] Level 08: Tuned down final boss laser attack, and switched it to plasma rope (feedback welcome!)
[*] Player weapon tuning (5 shot mirror orbs with piercing tuned down slightly)
[*] Difficulty select, normy mode now give 5 extra ships instead of 3
[*] Difficulty select, removed scoring on extra ship grants (just for level select) and now aware bonus score for heroic and normy modes to incentivize harder difficulty selection.
[*] Level 01: Mid boss second plasma laser is now updated visually
[*] Rank screen: changed secret found to secret collected to improve conveyance
[*] Rank screen: blue overlay now turns off after 20 seconds to improve ship visibility to fly into the end level portal
[*] Fixed a number of typos in the tutorial and rank screens
[*] Updated the game controllers list to support a much wider range of controllers
[*] Bullets were invisible during the 1st frame
[*] Tentative fix for warm-up sound sometimes looping forever
[*] Added a small fade to the Laser sound
[*] Added a sound fx fade at the end of levels
[/list]

[b]My own playthrough and dev commentary:[/b]
[previewyoutube=4Dagb_aNEzQ;full][/previewyoutube]
